issue_ledger.summary: A referenced designated workflow run is not mechanically bound to the same PR/head/base.
issue_ledger.exact_failure: trusted_bootstrap_success checks status description, run URL/path/event/conclusion/repo/actor but not the run's PR/head/base association. The completion workflow passes COMPLETED_BOOTSTRAP_RUN_ID, but reconcile_open_prs.py does not consume it; the positive test run fixture has no PR/head/base fields.
issue_ledger.proposed_protocol_2_5_fix_test: Require target run id==COMPLETED_BOOTSTRAP_RUN_ID when called from completion and verify workflow-run PR association carries exact PR/head/base (or equivalent immutable run attestation).
issue_ledger.required_test: Status on head B pointing to a real designated run for PR/head A must fail; trigger-run-id mismatch must fail.
issue_ledger.next_action: Repair before any future automated authority-changing admission.

issue_ledger.summary: Actions/wheels are pinned, but the validator OS/interpreter selectors remain mutable.
issue_ledger.exact_failure: Countable workflows run on ubuntu-latest and setup Python '3.13'. requirements-validation.lock hashes wheels but does not bind an OS image digest, exact Python build/executable or Git identity. PROTOCOL requires frozen direct/transitive dependencies or equivalent immutable environment receipt.
issue_ledger.proposed_protocol_2_5_fix_test: Use a digest-pinned validator image containing Python/Git/deps, or freeze/enforce an equivalent environment receipt with exact OS image, Python build/executable and Git identities.
issue_ledger.required_test: Moving runner/interpreter selectors without a qualifying frozen environment identity must not publish countable PASS.

issue_ledger.summary: VERIFIED_COMPLETE may carry verifier_assurance_records=[] without an explicit N/A disposition.
issue_ledger.exact_failure: branch_verification requires the field but has no minItems and VERIFIED_COMPLETE does not constrain it. Tests validate item shape only. Transport-only N/A and accidental omission are therefore indistinguishable.
issue_ledger.proposed_protocol_2_5_fix_test: Require records minItems>=1 or a mutually exclusive typed NOT_APPLICABLE_TRANSPORT_ONLY disposition; scientific verification must forbid N/A.
issue_ledger.required_test: VERIFIED_COMPLETE with [] and no explicit N/A must fail; explicit transport N/A passes; scientific N/A fails.
issue_ledger.next_action: Close explicit omission semantics before fresh/scientific verification.
